{{Top|leg}}
'''Kal'Shebbol starport''' was the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] serving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the planet's primary transportation hub for individuals either arriving at or leaving Kal'Shebbol. By 8 ABY, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], ruler of the planet, had instituted high tariffs at the starport, meaning that many independent traders and visitors to the planet often found themselves stranded when they could not afford the high docking bay fees and had their ships impounded. [[Free-trader]]s such as the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Loh'khar]] the Finder and [[Cobb Unser]] found themselves in this position.

Facilities at the starport included at least one [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], a [[Loh'khar's shop|trading post]] run by Loh'khar the Finder, and a [[Brophar Tofarain's repair yard|repair yard]] maintained by [[Brophar Tofarain]]. Shortly before the New Republic's liberation of the planet, the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Unda Lagor]] went on a rampage through one of the starport's busiest quarters, killing forty-three civilians and twenty-one Imperial troops. Several hidden rooms beneath the starport were also used by a [[Kal'Shebbol resistance group|resistance group]] as a base.

During the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of Kal'Shebbol by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces, several areas of the starport, including Tofarain's repair yard, took heavy damage.
